What to bring

Skip a return trip. Most renewals only need three things; bring the fourth if you have it.

Required documents
Current driver's license (even if expired)
Proof of residency dated within 90 days
Cash OR Visa, bank statement, link, debit
Payment for the $34 renewal fee — card or check, no cash above $20
Helpful, not required
Eyeglasses or contacts if you wear them (we test vision on site)
Updated address or emergency contact
Organ donor preference (yes, no, or "ask me a little later")
A book. Honestly. Even on time, we run a little behind.
The fine print, briefly
SCENARIO	WHAT HAPPENS	FEE?
Reschedule, 24+ hours ahead	Free, no questions asked	No
Reschedule, under 24 hours	One-time courtesy, second time you'll get charged	$7 fee
No show	Slot released, rebooking allowed after 48 hours	$15 fee
Missing documents on arrival	Check in deferred, you may join the walk-in queue same day	—
Office closure (weather, civic)	We move your slot to the next equivalent window	No fee
Accessibility & accommodations

All EF's offices are step-free, with assistive listening at every staffed counter and large-print forms available on request. Service animals welcome.
